newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian PM sets agenda for industrialists' meeting.
newsitem.headline: Indian PM sets agenda for industrialists' meeting.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda has set a 15-point agenda for his meeting next week with leading industrialists and economists on measures to boost the economy, the Press Trust of India said on Thursday.
The meeting, scheduled for Monday, will address apprehensions about the lack of transparency on policy issues, a current liquidity crunch and a fall in investor confidence, the news agency said.

High government spending, growth of exports, foreign direct investment, interest rates and the private sector's role in strengthening infrastructure and industry were also likely to be on the agenda, PTI said.
